meta: Drop-in opacity table and power-law fit for Data availability (Task 41).

grid.outside_hull: blank in the CSV, sentinel in the MESA files

mesa_format.note: this steam regime sits at log R 7-9; MESA's own tables run -8 to +1, so the files are in MESA's format but outside any MESA table's range

subneptune_kappa_R_mesa.interpolant: linear on the Delaunay triangulation in (T, log10 rho) over log10 kappa, the model's own

subneptune_kappa_P_mesa.interpolant: linear on the Delaunay triangulation in (T, log10 rho) over log10 kappa, the model's own

caveats: Interaction-induced absorption: These are first-principles molecular-dynamics opacities, so collision-induced and many-body absorption is present by construction and is not separable into a line list plus a pair continuum.

Dipole model: The spectra come from a machine-learned dipole surface whose symmetric-stretch derivative is 2.8x the revPBE0 value at 0.957 A and 4.0x at 1.00 A, so the 3200-4000 cm^-1 stretch band is too strong and kappa_P is affected more than kappa_R.
